items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There were other musicians, like Charlie Elgar and Hypolite Charles . . . no, not Hypolite. Was head of the Chicago union. Him and his wife played piano.

ctx.x: Sugar Johnny. I’ll have to check and see. I’m working on a Dodds thing right now.

Dodds was in Chicago. He was the first one in Chicago to keep the New Orleans tradition other than King Oliver and Louis Armstrong. There were other musicians, like Charlie Elgar and Hypolite Charles . . . no, not Hypolite. Was head of the Chicago union. Him and his wife played piano. Can’t think of their names.
Did you see people like . . . and hear King Oliver and them perform before they went up to Chicago?
